name: Proposal Calculator Biometric Verification Module
description: Calculator displays the biometric_verification_module as a provider-billed integration: appears with 'Agendar llamada' label instead of a price (is_invite=true, price_percent=0), and clicking the row reveals the invite_note. Sibling modules QR generator (25%) and AI content generator with editorial calendar (30%) are catalog-level only and structurally covered by existing calculator-modules and calculator-new-modules flows.
